title: Authorization enforced with assert in python — review required
description: An assert statement carries an authorization decision in python. Python removes every assert when the interpreter runs with -O, so the check disappears in exactly the optimised deployments that face real traffic. The rule flags asserts whose expression mentions a role, permission, or authentication predicate.
remediation: Replace the assert with an explicit conditional that raises a denial, and keep authorization in one middleware layer rather than scattered asserts.
limitation: Lexical: matches authorization-shaped assert expressions; custom predicate names are out of scope.
